meta.description: Ten simulations, thirty challenges. Each simulation has three challenges.

cartes.texte: Classify four security incidents by severity using scope, data sensitivity, and containment status.
Connect 4 devices to 3 switches while respecting capacity, subnet, and isolation constraints.
Tune a detection threshold and compare false positives, missed defects, and error costs.
Plan three days of replenishment without stockouts, respecting capacity and budget.
Select backlog items respecting capacity, dependencies, mandatory flags, and minimum value.
Program a route, avoid obstacles, and inspect every move in a simulated grid.
Reorder shuffled SQL clause fragments into the correct execution order.
Choose the execution order of 4 processes to meet deadlines and minimise average turnaround time.
Allocate quantities across 4 cost lines to stay within budget while meeting coverage and unit-cost targets.
Identify the complexity class (O(1), O(log n), O(n), O(n log n), O(n²), O(2ⁿ)) of common loop and recursion patterns.
